repairDescription: Repairs Office without losing documents or the license
repairConfirm: This is the quick repair: it downloads nothing and is usually enough. Documents and the license are left alone, but Word, Excel and PowerPoint will close.
repairDone: If the problem remains, try the online repair from Settings > Apps > Microsoft Office > Modify.
offlineDescription: Downloads the version chosen in Install to a folder, to install on other computers
chooseFolder: Choose where to save the installation files
configurationDescription: Shows exactly what will be asked of Microsoft
configurationMessage: This is what Microsoft's installer receives with what you chose on the Install screen.
workFolderDescription: Where OfficeGo leaves Microsoft's installer and its logs
uninstallDescription: The programs are removed. Documents are not deleted.
uninstallNote: Uninstalling asks you to type the word {{word}}: an accidental click is not enough.
uninstallConfirm: This will remove Office from this computer. Documents are NOT deleted.
uninstallDone: Office was removed from this computer.
